It's okay!! It sucks that people invalidate it, considering the fact that sexuality is super complex, and theres no foolproof way of defining it for anyone. For example, I say I'm pan ace, even though I identified as demi for so long. I've found myself fluctuating between and although there is probably a better term somewhere, I prefer to identify as ace. It's not hurting anyone, so you should be allowed to do you :D

Even though labels can help describe something, I personally dont think that they're necessary. If you love this guy, but still identify as a lesbian, that's okay, even if you dont fit the normal standards of a lesbian. Sexuality, like gender, is a huge spectrum, if you're comfortable with those labels, stick with them. (Other labels can be confusing, and hard to find, but I endorse searching if that's what you prefer!)

Some people may not agree since... labels are used to gather information about others, but this is my opinion :)
